mainEntity.name: What should I expect after structural wall framing is completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: When done correctly, structural wall framing should produce a wall that stays straight, carries loads properly, and supports the finishes without movement or cracking. In many Denver-area projects, the final outcome also depends on whether the framing matches the approved plan and passes inspection before the wall is closed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A correct job should leave you with a straight, stable wall that carries loads properly and passes inspection. The result should not be sagging, cracking, or out-of-plumb surfaces.
